senses.gloss: ch.<cite ref="Q02077">same</cite> <cite ref="Bava Metzia 42a:11">B. Mets. 42ᵃ</cite> <he>אע״ג דלענין גנבי נטירותא … פ׳ היא</he> although this was proper care as regards thieves, it was carelessness as regards fire.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 42a:11">Ib.</cite> <he>כל לא ידענא פ׳ הוא</he> every ‘I do not know’ (plea of ignorance) is considered an admission of indictable neglect; a. e.
